name: Guardian cryptic crossword, Penguin book 3 No 26

clue.text: Attractive Conservative hugged by Kate
One New Jersey river? That’s wrong
Eminence almost held in dread for a time
Love to sleep longer than usual, without the least effort
Poet’s cave, retreat of some hermit or gremlin
Insulting, rattling at grey door
Lengthening publicist’s pamphlet in Ghana’s capital
Smug parliamentarian, before clean-out, resting in bed
Fairy, quiet one, leading unknown couple
Only males come in at the junction
See bachelor charge back to vote
If any’s broken down, make fit
Reportedly stood in line encircling the ship, being obstinate
In an excited state, giving a giggle after grasping the point
A harridan, a bit of a dragon, but astute
Rustic one, tense by the sound of it, uneducated
Measure up in channel or passage
It’s the reverse of uncooked in fish and chicken
Variety of tea obtainable in English railway restaurant
Our chap upset in camp’s series of games
Fated for switch, or exchange by way of compromise
Sherpas, perhaps, seen wandering round enclosure
Former England opener, they say, was a philosopher
Type of shoe, neat, for dancing initially
Film, one made in Indian town
It’s beaten a seaman in a pleasure trip
